material_corrections: Animate Shinjuku is a single store at Marui Men 7F, not a multi-floor Animate building.
Zojoji Sangedatsumon conservation work is disclosed; an unobstructed historic gate view is not promised.
Omotesando Hills-only local visit is explicitly separate from a combined Harajuku planner model.
Kappabashi district access is distinguished from the longer approach to Ganso; TX Asakusa differs from Tobu/Toei Asakusa.
Meiji Jingu November and December closing times are shown separately; shrine-entrance time excludes at least ten more minutes to main buildings.
Paid-area access to ecute Shinagawa and two-hour admission-entry conditions are explicit.
uncertainties: No exact walking times or exit numbers added where reviewed official evidence was not textual or sufficiently clear.
Fukagawa access and barrier-free maps are image-led; no unsupported station exit number or complete step-free certification asserted.
Hanazono shrine-office hours and overnight grounds access were not asserted; festival conditions vary.
Shiodome walkway loop is not surveyed for continuous shelter, all-night access or step-free continuity.
Shop prices, stock and queue duration remain item/date dependent.

Hanazono Shrine official website returned HTTP 503 during direct verification; only tourism-association-backed access and general shrine advice were asserted, with no current festival dates or office hours.
